purpose: Gate commercial use independently for each selected Factory or Operating Model package without changing project decision authority, provider rights or the other package's access mode.

profileRules.WEBSITE: Default Website Factory and Website Operating Model are FREE_PUBLIC; paid compatible overrides, if selected, require entitlement only for the paid package.
profileRules.SOFTWARE_SAAS: Both selected Factory and selected Operating Model must be PAID_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED and each must have independently verified entitlement.
profileRules.BOOK: Both selected Factory and selected Operating Model must be PAID_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED and each must have independently verified entitlement.
